:::{#def-epigraph}
#### Epigraph

The **epigraph** of $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ is the set of points on or over its [graph](sets-functions.qmd#def-graph),

$$
\operatorname{epi} f \eqdef \cb{(\vx, s) : \vx \in \reals^p,\ s \in \reals,\ f(\vx) \le s}.
$$

A pair $(\vx, s)$ is treated as the $(p + 1)$-vector with entries $x_1, \ldots, x_p, s$,
so $\operatorname{epi} f \subseteq \reals^{p+1}$,
and sums and multiples of pairs are taken entry by entry.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-def-epigraph}
#### The epigraph of $x^2$

For $f(x) = x^2$, $\operatorname{epi} f = \cb{(x, s) : x^2 \le s}$,
the points $(x, s)$ on the parabola $s = x^2$ or on the side of it where $s$ is larger.
$(1, 2)$ is in it, since $1^2 \le 2$; $(2, 1)$ is not, since $2^2 > 1$.

:::
